english.title: Obstruct constable / authorised person empowered to inspect premises for licensing application etc
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) intentionally obstructed an authorised person exercising a power to enter premises, namely **(..SPECIFY THE PREMISES..), for the purpose of assessing the

(A)_[likely effect of the grant of an application for a premises licence under section 17]_
(B)_[likely effect of the grant of an application for a provisional statement under section 29]_
(C)_[likely effect of the grant of an application for a variation of a premises licence under section 34]_
(D)_[effect of the activities authorised by a premises licence issued under section 51]_

of the Licensing Act 2003 on the promotion of the licensing objectives
english.legislation: Contrary to section 59 of the Licensing Act 2003.
